inv.desc_es:
Local comercial acondicionado como bar en Nou Barris – BarcelonaOportunidad para emprendedores y profesionales de la hostelería.

Se ofrece local comercial situado en el distrito de Nou Barris, Barcelona, acondicionado para desarrollar una actividad de bar con restauración menor.

El inmueble cuenta con una superficie construida de 62 m² según Catastro y dispone de una distribución diseñada para aprovechar el espacio y facilitar el funcionamiento de un pequeño establecimiento de hostelería.

El local se distribuye en una zona principal de atención al público con barra y espacio para mesas, cocina interior y zona de almacén en altillo, dos aseos independientes, uno de ellos adaptado conforme al proyecto técnico de actividad.

Uno de sus principales atractivos es la documentación técnica existente para la actividad de bar con restauración menor, que incluye proyecto de actividad, planos, proyecto de legalización de la instalación eléctrica y certificado de conformidad emitido por una entidad de control en noviembre de 2015.

El proyecto contempla un aforo de 18 personas y una actividad orientada al servicio de bebidas, tapas frías y elaboraciones calientes sencillas mediante equipamiento eléctrico, sin necesidad de una cocina convencional. También disponía de licencia de terraza con 6 mesas.

Situado en un entorno residencial consolidado de Nou Barris, representa una opción interesante tanto para profesionales que deseen iniciar un negocio de proximidad como para quienes busquen un local previamente acondicionado para hostelería.

Una oportunidad para desarrollar tu proyecto de negocio en Barcelona.

Contacta con nosotros para ampliar información, consultar la documentación disponible o concertar una visita.

Nota: La documentación aportada acredita la conformidad de la actividad en 2015. La vigencia actual del título habilitante y las condiciones para su cambio de titular están pendientes de confirmación municipal.

inv.desc_en:
Commercial premises fitted out as a bar in Nou Barris – Barcelona. Opportunity for entrepreneurs and hospitality professionals.

Commercial premises for rent/sale located in the Nou Barris district, Barcelona, fitted out to operate as a bar with minor catering services.

The property has a constructed area of 62 m² according to the Land Registry and features a layout designed to maximize space and facilitate the operation of a small hospitality establishment.

The premises are distributed into a main customer service area with a bar and space for tables, an interior kitchen and storage area in a loft, and two independent restrooms, one of which is adapted in accordance with the technical activity project.

One of its main attractions is the existing technical documentation for the bar activity with minor catering, which includes the activity project, floor plans, electrical installation legalization project, and a certificate of conformity issued by a control entity in November 2015.

The project allows for a capacity of 18 people and an activity focused on serving drinks, cold tapas, and simple hot dishes prepared using electrical equipment, without the need for a conventional kitchen. It also previously held a terrace license for 6 tables.

Located in a well-established residential area of Nou Barris, it represents an interesting option both for professionals wishing to start a local business and for those looking for premises previously fitted out for hospitality.

An opportunity to develop your business project in Barcelona.

Contact us for more information, to consult the available documentation, or to arrange a visit.

Note: The documentation provided certifies the conformity of the activity in 2015. The current validity of the enabling title and the conditions for its transfer of ownership are pending municipal confirmation.

IF YOU PLACE YOUR TRUST IN US AND DECIDE TO BUY THROUGH US, YOU WILL SEE THAT YOU WILL BUY AT THE ADVERTISED PRICE AND THAT WE DO NOT CHARGE EXTRA FEES ON TOP OF THE SALE PRICE. THE PRICE DOES NOT INCLUDE ITP EXPENSES 5-10% (PROPERTY TRANSFER TAX), DOCUMENTED LEGAL ACTS, PROPERTY REGISTRY, OR NOTARY FEES 1%. AICAT 0268 - 1247

Legal notice: The information contained in this advertisement is merely informative, non-contractual, and may be subject to modifications without prior notice. All data offered (including images, prices, measurements, or descriptions) are indicative and non-binding, and do not constitute any offer or contractual commitment. In compliance with current legislation on real estate advertising, it is guaranteed that this advertisement complies with the provisions of the Consumer and User Defense Law, the corresponding regional regulations, and other applicable standards regarding transparency, truthfulness, and consumer protection. The data has been collected with the authorization of the property owner, and its publication is carried out in accordance with the principle of legitimate interest and commercial purpose, as established by Organic Law 3/2018 (LOPDGDD) and the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). If you believe that personal or identifying information has been published without consent, you may exercise your rights by contacting us via [email/phone], and your request will be handled in accordance with the law. The published images may have been digitally edited for brightness or visual spaciousness purposes, without substantially altering the representation of the property. It is recommended to arrange an in-person visit to verify all its features. Any typographical or transcription error in this advertisement will not imply any contractual obligation for the agency.
